website.readmeExcerpt:
![XIV Instant Edit](docs/images/banner.png)

# XIV Instant Edit

Instant Edit is a Final Fantasy XIV Dalamud plugin that sends the models, textures and animations you see in game
straight into your editing software, and puts your changes straight back into your Penumbra mods, without manual
importing, exporting or file juggling. Model editing uses a Blender add-on, and works on vanilla game files as well as
Penumbra mods.

**The [wiki](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki) explains every feature step by step.**

## Features

- **Models in Blender**: send any model on your character (or minions, mounts, summons) to Blender with one click, then export it back in place, into another mod option, a new mod or automatically creating a mashup of several mods. Imports automatically generate a compatible skeleton.\
  [Guide](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/Editing-a-Model-in-Blender)
- **Textures**: edit textures in Photoshop, GIMP, Krita, Paint.NET or any TGA editor, including saving texture variants and directly setting them up as Penumbra option groups. \
  [Guide](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/Editing-Textures)
- **Substance Painter**: paint directly on any model with the exact textures you're currently using and save your edits back to the game with just one click. "Paint my Skin" under quick actions sends your entire character with your configured small clothes body, letting you easily create custom skin, tattoo and makeup mods.\
  [Guide](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/Painting-in-Substance-Painter)
- **Animations**: the listener finds the animation your character currently plays. Open them in the timeline, or load any emote, idle,\
  sit, movement track or expression onto your GPose character from there. Edit the animations length, sounds, expressions,\
  lip sync, effects and props, with a preview in GPose. Change how the animation moves your character through various editing layers: offsets work similar to LivePose bone offsets, but can be applied more granular over a limited time range of the animation to fix clipping. Amplitude layers let you easily control the strength of motions, while Pose Layers let you create your own animation from Poses, smoothly blending between them. Send the motion to Blender, edit it there, and bring it back into the timeline. \
  [Editing](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/Editing-Animations) ·
  [Timeline](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/Editing-the-Timeline) ·
  [In Blender](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/Animations-in-Blender)
- **Game Files**: browse the game's own models, edit them, or batch-export their files and skeletons.
  [Guide](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/Game-Files)
- **Mod Browser**: open any Penumbra mod in its own window to see its options, models, textures, animations, effects and
  sounds. Drop your own files on anything to replace it, send its files to your editors, check it for problems and
  clean it up, with every change backed up.\
  [Guide](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/The-Mod-Browser)
- **Build a mod** (Beta): make a new mod from gear, weapons or animations of another game. Import Sims 4 and Unity
  packages or folders of loose files, drag their models and textures onto the game item you replace, and build it into
  Penumbra.\
  [Guide](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/Building-a-New-Mod)
- **Quick Actions**: tasks for your whole character.
  - Fix skin seams between models, such as on your neck or between different face parts, like face and ears. Textures and materials are automatically blended into each other, getting rid of visible seams between models and parts.  \
    [Guide](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/Fixing-the-Neck-Seam)
  - Optimize your character textures automatically: uncompressed mod textures get evaluated as they load and only get compressed if there is no loss in visual quality, reducing the VRAM requirements by 75% and keeping your character nice and slim at all times for sync plugins. Hair mods whose texture layouts only use a small section of their textures, like many Sims 4 hair\
    ports, automatically have their textures and UVs cropped to save memory at no impact to visuals. The originals are backed up and can be restored for loaded models at any time.
  - Automatically fix your [Simple Heels](https://github.com/Caraxi/SimpleHeels) offset: measure how far shoes reach below the\
    ground and write the offset into the model file through an attribute, so heels stand on the ground instead of sinking into it.
  - Build body physics (Beta) for your chest and the areas your IVCS or YAS skeleton adds bones for, fitted to your
    body and previewed on your character before you save.\
    [Guide](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/Body-Physics)

## Requirements

- [XIVLauncher](https://goatcorp.github.io/) with Dalamud enabled
- [Penumbra](https://github.com/xivdev/Penumbra) 1.7.1.0 or newer
- [Blender](https://www.blender.org/) 4.5.0 or newer for model editing
- Optional: an image editor that saves 32-bit TGA files, [Substance 3D Painter](https://www.adobe.com/products/substance3d/apps/painter.html)
  10.0.1 or newer, and the LivePose plugin for animation editing

## Installation

1. In FFXIV, run `/xlsettings`, open **Experimental** and add this under **Custom Plugin Repositories**:
   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/link-0402/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json
   ```
2. Save, open `/xlplugins` and install **XIV Instant Edit**.
3. Open it with `/ie`. The first-time setup picks a cache folder, then finds Blender, your image editors and
   Substance Painter and sets them up, including the Blender add-on.

To install the Blender add-on by hand, add this remote repository under **Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions >
Repositories** and turn on **Check for Updates on Startup**, so the add-on stays in step with the plugin:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/main/Blender-Addon/blender_repo/index.json
```

See [Installation and setup](https://github.com/link-0402/XIV-Instant-Edit/wiki/Installation-and-Setup) for details,
supported editor versions and manual setup, and the add-on's [README](Blender-Addon/README.md) for its sidebar.

## Credits and links

- The Blender add-on was initially derived from [Yet Another Addon](https://github.com/Arrenval/Yet-Another-Addon) and
  [XIVPy](https://github.com/Arrenval/XIVPy) by Arrenval; see [its credits](Blender-Addon/README.md#credits-and-license).
- The animation tools adapt code from [VFXEditor](https://github.com/0ceal0t/Dalamud-VFXEditor) by 0ceal0t and follow
  [LivePose](https://github.com/Caraxi/LivePose) by Caraxi; see [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).
- The motion editor's Bones window and its bones on the character adapt [Brio](https://github.com/Etheirys/Brio) by
  Etheirys and contributors, including its posing artwork.

## Contributing

Bug reports and feature ideas are welcome. To contribute code, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup,
testing and submission guidance.

## License

This is an unofficial community tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix, Dalamud, Penumbra, or
Blender. The project is licensed under the [GNU GPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSE).
